grow NVIDIA's business, develop new products, or sell NVIDIA's products.","Acquisition and investment challenges could ultimately hurt NVIDIA's financial results.","Pursuing a particular transaction could limit NVIDIA's ability to enter other transactions that could support other strategic objectives.","Failure to complete an acquisition on time could prevent NVIDIA from pursuing other transactions.","Delays in regulatory approvals could prevent NVIDIA from completing acquisitions on time.","Failure to complete an acquisition on time could prevent NVIDIA from retaining critical talent from the target company.","Technology could evolve and make an acquisition less attractive before completion.","Regulators could impose conditions that reduce the ultimate value of an acquisition.","Investments in companies could cause volatility and fluctuations in NVIDIA's results, including realized and unrealized gains or losses.","NVIDIA could lose up to the full value of an investment.","Many companies receiving NVIDIA investments may not achieve profitability in the near term or at all.","NVIDIA has no guarantee of a return on investments in companies.","Some private-company investments involve early-stage companies still defining strategic direction.","Many securities held through private-company investments are non-marketable and illiquid at the time of initial investment.","If an investee company is unsuccessful, NVIDIA could recognize an impairment or lose all or part of the investment.","NVIDIA's investment portfolio carries industry-sector concentration risks.","A decline in one or more industry sectors could increase impairment losses.","Additional risks include diversion of capital and management attention.","Additional risks include difficulty realizing a satisfactory return.","Additional risks include difficulty obtaining governmental or regulatory approvals or financing.","Additional risks include legal proceedings arising from a deal.","Additional risks include failure of due diligence to identify significant issues.","Acquisition-specific risks include difficulty integrating technology, systems, operations, and key personnel.","Acquisition-specific risks include assumed liabilities, amortization expenses, goodwill impairment charges, and write-downs of acquired assets.","Acquisition-specific risks include difficulty integrating accounting, forecasting, and controls.","An acquisition's failure to obtain regulatory approval or close could affect NVIDIA's stock price and cause fines, fees, or reputational harm.","Debt-financed acquisitions could increase NVIDIA's debt and interest expense and create covenant-compliance risks.","Acquisitions could involve dilutive equity issuances and variability in performance-based consideration.","Negative changes in economic conditions pose acquisition-related risks.","Acquisitions could create additional cybersecurity risks and impair relationships with employees, vendors, and customers.","NVIDIA says NVIDIA has experienced challenges integrating acquisition-target systems.","NVIDIA's acquisition-system integration has involved lengthy and costly work and delays in purchasing and shipping products.","NVIDIA says acquisition-system integration challenges have affected results of operations and may continue to affect results of operations.","NVIDIA's FY2026 10-K says NVIDIA is finalizing an investment and partnership agreement with OpenAI.","NVIDIA's FY2026 10-K provides no assurance that NVIDIA will enter into an investment and partnership agreement with OpenAI or complete a transaction.","The MD&A says NVIDIA invested $17.5 billion in private companies and infrastructure funds during fiscal year 2026.","The fiscal year 2026 investments primarily involved early-stage startups, including AI model makers that purchase NVIDIA products.","Many fiscal year 2026 investments are illiquid and non-marketable.","NVIDIA provided $3.5 billion in land, power, and shell guarantees to early-stage companies.","If escrow and partner operating activities are insufficient to cover a default, NVIDIA may assume the underlying leases or sublease the leases."]}
